title: A Friend Loves at All Times

questions.question: Better is a dry morsel with quiet than a house full of feasting with what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:1 (ESV): "than a house full of feasting with strife."

questions.question: Grandchildren are the crown of the aged, and the glory of children is their what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:6 (ESV): "and the glory of children is their fathers."

questions.question: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:17 (ESV): "and a brother is born for adversity."

questions.question: A joyful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:22 (ESV): "but a crushed spirit dries up the bones."

questions.question: Even a fool who keeps silent is considered wise; when he closes his lips, he is deemed what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:28 (ESV): "when he closes his lips, he is deemed intelligent."

questions.question: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace is for gold, and the Lord tests what?
Whoever covers an offense seeks love, but he who repeats a matter separates whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:9 (ESV): "but he who repeats a matter separates close friends."

questions.question: The beginning of strife is like letting out water, so quit before the quarrel breaks what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:14 (ESV): "so quit before the quarrel breaks out."

questions.question: He who justifies the wicked and he who condemns the righteous are both alike an abomination to whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:15 (ESV): "are both alike an abomination to the Lord."

questions.question: A man of understanding is cool of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:27 (ESV): "and a man of understanding is cool of spirit."

questions.question: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who acts how?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:2 (ESV): "will rule over a son who acts shamefully"

questions.question: Usually, the one who mocks the poor insults his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:5 (ESV): "Whoever mocks the poor insults his Maker;"

questions.question: If a man returns evil for good, evil will not depart from his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:13 (ESV): "evil will not depart from his house."

questions.question: Why should a fool have money in his hand to buy wisdom when he has no what?
It is not good to be partial to the wicked or to deprive the righteous of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 17:26 (ESV): "or to deprive the righteous of justice."

key_verse_text: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
